grains.RAW.PLANNING_ITEMS: one row per planning item (distribution centre and product category)
grains.RAW.ITEM_DAILY: one row per planning item per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.SUPPLIER_CONFIRMATIONS: one row per planning item (supplier capacity confirmation snapshot)
grains.CURATED.EXCEPTION_SUMMARY: one row per plan exception type
grains.ML.STOCKOUT_RISK_SCORES: one row per planning item (latest day)
grains.ML.DEMAND_FORECAST: one row per forecast day (14 days)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide demand FORECAST (units per day); forecast error ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.EXCEPTION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic plan exception handling SOPs (one per product category and exception type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.DEMAND_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.DEMAND_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, planning item, exception-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (planning items, daily plan exceptions, stockouts by planning item, stockout risk, demand events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_DEMAND
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_DEMAND_ALERT logs new EXCEPTION events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.stockout_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(stockout for the planning item in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
